metadata.title: Trastuzumab Intravenous Monotherapy – 7 days
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: Initial loading 4 mg/kg; omit loading when continuing from a trastuzumab-containing regimen. Review missed-dose history separately.
audit_limitations: Other cancer medicines in combination indications require the complete combination protocol; this card encodes trastuzumab only.
Independent clinical and pharmacy validation pending.

retrospective_review_v08414.status: Source reconciliation; independent oncology/pharmacy approval pending

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

indications.description: HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer; intravenous trastuzumab every 7 days.

administration.notes: Initial loading 4 mg/kg; omit loading when continuing from a trastuzumab-containing regimen. Review missed-dose history separately.

rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Evaluate supplied values independently. Missing values remain unassessed; never infer normality or phase.

action.recommendation: Relevant drug / excipient allergy: do not administer. SC trastuzumab also contains hyaluronidase.

rules.explanation: Relevant drug / excipient allergy: do not administer. SC trastuzumab also contains hyaluronidase.

action.recommendation: Do not proceed without urgent oncology / obstetric risk-benefit review. Pregnancy is not labelled an absolute SmPC contraindication; fetal harm is possible.

rules.explanation: Do not proceed without urgent oncology / obstetric risk-benefit review. Pregnancy is not labelled an absolute SmPC contraindication; fetal harm is possible.

action.recommendation: Breastfeeding must be stopped during treatment and for 7 months after the final dose; discuss the individual plan before treatment.

rules.explanation: Breastfeeding must be stopped during treatment and for 7 months after the final dose; discuss the individual plan before treatment.

action.recommendation: Outside the NCCP performance-status population: consultant review required.

rules.explanation: Outside the NCCP performance-status population: consultant review required.

action.recommendation: The source requires validated HER2-positive disease. Reconcile tumour testing before selecting this regimen.

rules.explanation: The source requires validated HER2-positive disease. Reconcile tumour testing before selecting this regimen.

action.recommendation: The full source indication / prior treatment criteria have not been confirmed. Review the regimen choice.

rules.explanation: The full source indication / prior treatment criteria have not been confirmed. Review the regimen choice.

action.recommendation: Clinically significant cardiac disease is an NCCP exclusion; do not administer without specialist reassessment of the treatment plan.

rules.explanation: Clinically significant cardiac disease is an NCCP exclusion; do not administer without specialist reassessment of the treatment plan.

action.recommendation: Required cardiac monitoring is unavailable. Arrange the result and documented consultant decision before the next administration; do not assume normal function.

rules.explanation: Required cardiac monitoring is unavailable. Arrange the result and documented consultant decision before the next administration; do not assume normal function.

action.recommendation: Grade 4 hypersensitivity: discontinue and manage the reaction urgently.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 hypersensitivity: discontinue and manage the reaction urgently.

action.recommendation: This NCCP card covers metastatic breast cancer. Use the setting-specific regimen; do not transfer duration or partner-drug rules.

rules.explanation: This NCCP card covers metastatic breast cancer. Use the setting-specific regimen; do not transfer duration or partner-drug rules.

action.recommendation: Reduced baseline LVEF requires individual cardiac risk-benefit assessment. The metastatic source does not assign the early-breast >55% threshold.

rules.explanation: Reduced baseline LVEF requires individual cardiac risk-benefit assessment. The metastatic source does not assign the early-breast >55% threshold.

action.recommendation: Hold for LVEF <50% AND fall ≥10 percentage points. Repeat after 3 weeks; consider discontinuation if not improved / further decline and refer to cardiology.

rules.explanation: Hold for LVEF <50% AND fall ≥10 percentage points. Repeat after 3 weeks; consider discontinuation if not improved / further decline and refer to cardiology.

action.recommendation: Current LVEF is below 50%. Obtain the baseline change to interpret the combined hold rule; do not infer a small fall.

rules.explanation: Current LVEF is below 50%. Obtain the baseline change to interpret the combined hold rule; do not infer a small fall.

action.recommendation: Discontinue and refer urgently for cardiology review.

rules.explanation: Discontinue and refer urgently for cardiology review.

action.recommendation: Severe dyspnoea at rest from advanced malignancy / comorbidity is a product contraindication. Urgent clinical review.

rules.explanation: Severe dyspnoea at rest from advanced malignancy / comorbidity is a product contraindication. Urgent clinical review.

action.recommendation: Do not give concurrently with an anthracycline under this card. Review the complete source-specific regimen and cardiac risk before administration.

rules.explanation: Do not give concurrently with an anthracycline under this card. Review the complete source-specific regimen and cardiac risk before administration.

action.recommendation: Reversible chemotherapy-induced myelosuppression does not itself mandate a trastuzumab dose reduction. Review complications and any companion chemotherapy separately.

rules.explanation: Reversible chemotherapy-induced myelosuppression does not itself mandate a trastuzumab dose reduction. Review complications and any companion chemotherapy separately.

action.recommendation: One week or less late: give maintenance 2 mg/kg as soon as clinically appropriate, then resume the previous schedule. Verify prior dose and cardiac review.

rules.explanation: One week or less late: give maintenance 2 mg/kg as soon as clinically appropriate, then resume the previous schedule. Verify prior dose and cardiac review.

action.recommendation: More than one week late: source describes 4 mg/kg re-loading at clinician discretion, followed by 2 mg/kg weekly. Confirm the actual history; no automatic restart dose is issued.

rules.explanation: More than one week late: source describes 4 mg/kg re-loading at clinician discretion, followed by 2 mg/kg weekly. Confirm the actual history; no automatic restart dose is issued.

action.recommendation: Pause or slow the infusion and assess the reaction. Provide appropriate treatment and observe until symptoms resolve; restart requires the treating team’s decision.

rules.explanation: Pause or slow the infusion and assess the reaction. Provide appropriate treatment and observe until symptoms resolve; restart requires the treating team’s decision.
